decks.summary: Pure-caster Diana for Hard: cancels from Deny Existence, Ward of Protection and Dark Prophecy stack willpower under her, then Shrivelling, Sixth Sense and Storm of Spirits do the work; complex.

The first Practicing Safe Hex: Diana cancels treacheries to grow her willpower, draws heavily through Arcane Initiate, and fights and investigates with Shrivelling, Rite of Seeking and Enchanted Blade.
Eldritch Knight Diana who fights with Machete and Beat Cop while nine cancel effects feed her ability, and Prepared for the Worst finds weapons and Twilight Blade to reuse cancels.
Slow-burn multiplayer Diana who cancels surgically instead of constantly, leaning on Flashlight and the .45 early and unleashing Shrivelling once her willpower has grown.
Eldritch Knight revisited: Empower Self, Well Prepared, The Hungering Blade and Twilight Blade build to repeatable high-damage attacks, with Ever Vigilant and Uncage the Soul to set up fast.
Gun-fu Diana who ignores willpower: .35 Winchesters, Thompsons and Bandoliers with Grete Wagner and "Eat lead!", and cancel-triggering cards like Marksmanship and Olive McBride feeding her ability.
Hard-mode Diana built to reach 5 or 6 willpower reliably with ten cancel effects and Arcane Initiate, then power Shrivelling, Sixth Sense and Wither.
Tank Diana on Guardian cards: .45 Automatics, Guard Dog and Survival Knives fight while her cancels grow her willpower, and "Let me handle this!" and Delay the Inevitable protect the team.
Combo Diana who seals every token but the elder sign, Transfigures into Winifred and uses Katarina Sojka to reveal it on every test for endless draw and damage; a thought experiment more than a deck.
Maximum Empower Diana: Lucid Dreaming finds all three Empower Selves, Well Prepared and Twilight Blade stack on them, and Enchanted Armor and Bind Monster handle what attacks her.
